newsitem.title: ITALY: Arafat to stop over in Italy for talks - PLO.
newsitem.headline: Arafat to stop over in Italy for talks - PLO.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat is to make a stop-over in Italy on Friday for talks with Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi and Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini, PLO sources said on Friday.

The sources, based in Italy, said the meeting would take place in the southern city of Naples, where Prodi and Dini are holding a bilateral summit with French President Jacques Chirac. "Arafat will go to Naples," one of the sources said.

Arafat's spokesman Nabil Abu Rdainah told Reuters in Tunis earlier that the meeting would take place in Rome, where Arafat would make an airport stop-over for two hours on his way to a meeting with Chirac in Paris.
The Italian Foreign Ministry had no immediate details.

"Arafat is very welcome. As he is on his way to Europe we can't exclude that he would make a stopover," a spokesman for Dini said. French officials said Chirac's separate evening meeting in Paris with Arafat was still going ahead.
Arafat is due to brief Chirac on the Middle East peace summit he held with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and King Hussein of Jordan in Washington earlier this week.
